mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ITEM-KEYSTONE TRIGGER kit -- the founding item-trigger legend (introduced 1.1.2; eras 2.x;3.0-3.6 CONFIRMED). Crosswalk s4 names it: mechanic-granting unique (Mjolner trigger) -> trigger grammar as kit-declared fields; the ITEM DISSOLVES and its mechanic lands on the kit: proc_trigger_condition=on-hit-threshold (every hit, ICD-gated) + consequence_type=linked-cast + apply-only shape (b04 generals-cry precedent for non-mark linked-cast kits; b02 coc-ice-nova precedent for attack-hosts-spell triggers) -- DEPTH-1: swing triggers spell; the spell's chain hops are GEOMETRY, not further trigger depth. persistent_condition_shape=proc-loop is the engine's own PC shape for proc-cadence kits (econ_raw 'trigger-on-hit-cadence'). The 0.25s ICD is a cadence CAP with no dedicated carrier (cadence_scale rejected -- it scales the kit's own cooldown table, not a trigger ICD; noted instead, R-M4 honesty). Free-cost triggered payload: cost_scale=0.0 rejected as chassis overreach (the swings still cost normally); noted in scaffold economy. Doors: RESONANCE_LOOP (verified Layer-2 SEQUENCE -> THRESHOLD_BURST = swing-sequence -> cooldown-gated spell burst) + ELEMENTAL_ECHO (mono-lightning); coc-ice-nova's GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE not inherited (its door expressed Ice Nova's ring-collapse payload; Arc's chain payload needs no geometry door). Socket-order cast-priority (Funsy 2014 empirical) is source lore -- behavioral, un-carried.
mapping_json.motion_frame: storm-hammer juggernaut: wade in swinging, and every connecting swing detonates free chain-lightning out of the hammer -- melee cadence IS the cast cadence; the spells are the damage, the swings are the metronome

spine.mech_note: Mjölner unique mace: socketed lightning spells cast on HIT with the weapon automatically. Every melee strike with Mjölner triggers all socketed lightning spells simultaneously — melee hit-rate becomes cast-rate. Classical configuration: socketed Discharge (consumes all endurance/power/frenzy charges for a damage nova), generating charges through Juggernaut (endurance) or Assassin (power). The item-trigger loop: swing Mjölner → hit triggers Discharge → nova kills pack → charges regenerate → repeat. Charge generation rate must match Discharge consumption. Patch history: heavily nerfed in 2.0 (Discharge cost raised; Mjölner nerfed to once-per-0.5s), which killed the most broken configurations. Resurgences in later leagues (3.x Cyclone at high attack speed reactivated it). One of PoE's founding item-trigger legends — predates CoC as an explicit mechanic by establishing the template.
